    Theorem B in the independent vocabulary #

    The independent family is a skeleton of the proof library; its standardness there (theoremB) transfers to the independent mesh category, because the independent translate is the translation of Γ_A (translateCompatible) and the coefficients of the mesh relations normalize to one (Lemma 4.4).
